Create Backtrader Multi-Factor strategy Create tests/validation/strategies/backtrader/multi_factor.py Use Backtrader's built-in indicators (bt.indicators.EMA, RSI, MACD) Implement equivalent factor logic Ensure log output matches rustybt format

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: rustybt Multi-Factor implementation exists at tests/validation/strategies/rustybt/multi_factor.py with RustyBTValidatedStrategy base, three indicators EMA(50), RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), default params ema_period=50, rsi_period=14, macd_fast=12, macd_slow=26, macd_signal=9, buy when ALL conditions met (Price greater than EMA, 50 less than RSI less than 70, MACD greater than Signal), sell when ANY condition fails or RSI greater than 80

Backtrader Multi-Factor implementation exists at tests/validation/strategies/backtrader/multi_factor.py with BacktraderValidatedStrategy base, bt.indicators.EMA, bt.indicators.RSI, bt.indicators.MACD, logically equivalent to rustybt, same default parameters

Factor scoring system implemented: each factor returns 1 (bullish) or 0 (not bullish), entry requires all factors = 1 (score = 3), exit when any factor = 0 or RSI greater than 80, log individual factor values for debugging
Strategy audit checklist passed: same EMA calculation, same RSI calculation (may be DESIGN), same MACD calculation (may be DESIGN), same factor combination logic, same entry/exit conditions
Log individual factor values for debugging: log each indicator value on every bar, log factor scores (0 or 1) for each factor, log combined signal with factor breakdown
Unit tests verify: EMA calculation accuracy, RSI calculation accuracy, MACD calculation accuracy, factor scoring logic, entry/exit conditions
